tests.label: Complete PO – Pellucid
tests.description: Well-formed email PO from known buyer, all SKUs resolvable.

tests.label: Missing Quantity – Pellucid
tests.description: PO email with line items missing quantity fields.

tests.label: Spam / Non-PO
tests.description: Marketing newsletter — should be rejected as non-order.

tests.label: Ambiguous Order – Ironfeld
tests.description: Vague subject and body; confidence expected to be low.

tests.label: PDF Attachment – Clean
tests.description: Email with a clean, machine-readable PDF purchase order.

tests.label: PDF Attachment – Degraded
tests.description: Email with a scanned/degraded PDF; extraction confidence may be low.

tests.label: PDF Attachment – Unknown Buyer
tests.description: Email with PDF from an unrecognised sender domain — customer unresolved after full cascade. Routed to Human Review so operator can identify the account.

tests.label: Cascade – Email Domain Match
tests.description: No account ID provided; sender email domain matches PELC-001 at cascade step 2.

tests.label: Cascade – Fuzzy Buyer
tests.description: No account ID, email, or phone match; company name partially matches at cascade step 4 — goes to Human Review with customer candidates.

tests.label: CSV – Valid Order
tests.description: Clean CSV PO from Pellucid; all SKUs resolve exactly.

tests.label: CSV – Unknown SKU
tests.description: CSV PO containing buyer SKUs with no exact match — AI finds partial candidates between thresholds, so operator must select the correct SKU. Routes to Human Review with candidate list.

tests.label: XLSX – Backorder
tests.description: Spreadsheet PO where one item is on backorder — auto-submits with backorder_eta in ERP payload.

tests.label: XLSX – No Stock
tests.description: Spreadsheet PO for items with zero available inventory and not backorderable.

tests.label: X12 850 – Valid
tests.description: Well-formed ANSI X12 850 from known trading partner.

tests.label: X12 850 – Missing Line Item Field
tests.description: X12 850 with a PO1 segment missing unit of measure — clarification reply sent.

tests.label: X12 850 – Unknown Buyer
tests.description: X12 850 from an ISA sender ID not in the customer list — customer unresolved after full cascade. Routed to Human Review so operator can identify the account.

tests.label: CSV – Backorder Mix
tests.description: CSV PO with a mix of in-stock and backordered items — auto-submits with backorder flag.

tests.label: XLSX – Unknown Buyer
tests.description: Spreadsheet PO from a company not in the customer registry — customer unresolved after full cascade. Routed to Human Review so operator can identify the account.

tests.label: CSV – SKU Mid-Confidence (Auto-Resolve)
tests.description: Buyer SKU is a plausible abbreviation of a catalogue SKU; AI confidence expected at or above SKU_AUTO_THRESHOLD. Tests auto-resolve path with reasoning logged.

tests.label: CSV – SKU Mid-Confidence (Review)
tests.description: Buyer SKU is ambiguous; AI returns multiple candidates between SKU_REVIEW_THRESHOLD and SKU_AUTO_THRESHOLD. Tests Human Review with candidate list.

tests.label: Cascade – Phone Match (Step 3)
tests.description: No account ID or email domain match; buyer phone number matches TRCL-002 after E.164 normalisation at cascade step 3.

tests.label: Cascade – Explicit Account ID (Step 1)
tests.description: Buyer provides account ID explicitly; resolved immediately at cascade step 1 with no further lookup needed.

tests.label: CSV – Duplicate PO Number
tests.description: PO number and customer account ID identical to a previously processed order within DUPLICATE_PO_WINDOW_DAYS. Must be rejected as duplicate.
tests.notes: Run this test after edi-01 has been processed successfully. Uses same PO number PO-2026-0301.

tests.label: CSV – Mixed Line Resolution
tests.description: Order with 4 line items: 2 exact SKU matches, 1 fuzzy match above auto-threshold, 1 unknown SKU. Tests mixed resolution state routing to Human Review.

tests.label: CSV – Large Order (10 Lines)
tests.description: Order with 10 line items, all SKUs resolvable. Tests pipeline performance and ERP payload structure with multiple lines.

tests.label: CSV – Price Discrepancy
tests.description: Line total in CSV does not match quantity × unit price. Tests whether the extraction catches and flags the discrepancy.

tests.label: CSV – Zero Quantity Line
tests.description: One line item has quantity of zero. Tests business rule validation for invalid quantity.

tests.label: XLSX – Missing PO Number
tests.description: Valid XLSX order with all line items present but no PO number — missing required order-level field.

tests.label: CSV – Empty File
tests.description: Zero-byte CSV file dropped in EDI inbox. Pipeline must handle gracefully — log error, move to edi-error/, do not crash.
tests.notes: Verify file moves to edi-error/ and error event written to audit log. Pipeline must continue running.

tests.label: CSV – Headers Only (No Rows)
tests.description: CSV file with valid headers but no data rows. Tests parser behaviour with structurally valid but empty content.

tests.label: XLSX – Corrupted File
tests.description: XLSX file with invalid/corrupted binary content. Parser must fail gracefully — error logged, file moved to edi-error/.
tests.notes: Create by renaming a .txt file to .xlsx. Verify pipeline does not crash.

tests.label: Email – No Subject
tests.description: Valid PO email with no subject line. Tests extraction with missing metadata.

tests.label: Email – HTML Body Only
tests.description: PO email with only an HTML body and no plain text part. Tests mailparser HTML fallback.

tests.label: Email – Multiple Attachments
tests.description: Email with both a PDF and XLSX attachment. Tests parser selection logic — pipeline should use the PDF.

tests.label: Email – Special Characters in Company Name
tests.description: Buyer company name contains accented characters and punctuation (e.g. 'Société Générale & Co.'). Tests extraction and customer matching with non-ASCII content.

tests.label: Email – Very Long Order (25 Lines)
tests.description: Email PO with 25 line items, all resolvable. Tests extraction token limits and ERP payload size.

tests.label: Email – International Address (Canada)
tests.description: PO from a Canadian buyer with a Canadian shipping address. Tests address parsing with non-US postal format.

tests.label: CSV – Non-USD Currency
tests.description: CSV order with currency set to CAD. Tests extraction and ERP payload with non-USD currency.

tests.label: X12 850 – Multiple PO1 Segments
tests.description: X12 850 with 5 PO1 line item segments, mix of in-stock and backorderable items.

tests.label: X12 850 – Missing BEG Segment
tests.description: X12 850 with no BEG (beginning of order) segment — PO number unextractable. Tests parser error handling.

tests.label: Email – Phishing / Social Engineering
tests.description: Email disguised as a PO but requesting payment details or credentials. Tests Claude's legitimacy assessment.

tests.label: Email – Order Cancellation
tests.description: Email explicitly cancelling a previous order rather than placing a new one. System should reject as not a new PO.

tests.label: Email – Order Amendment
tests.description: Email amending a quantity on an existing PO ('please change line 2 from 50 to 75 units'). System should route to Human Review — not auto-process as a new order.

tests.label: Email – Confidence at Submit Threshold
tests.description: Carefully crafted order where extraction confidence is expected to land at or just above CONFIDENCE_SUBMIT_THRESHOLD (85%). Tests boundary between submit and review.
tests.notes: Outcome may vary depending on Claude's extraction confidence. Treat as a monitor test rather than a hard assertion.

tests.label: Email – Rush Order
tests.description: PO email marked urgent with requested delivery within 24 hours. Tests extraction of priority signals and whether they flow through to the ERP payload.

tests.label: CSV – Partial Stock (Split Needed)
tests.description: Order for 50 units of GSKT-A1-STD where only 8 are available and item is not backorderable. Tests Human Review routing with partial availability context.

tests.label: Email – Repeat Order Reference
tests.description: Buyer references a previous order ('same as last month, PO-2026-0101'). Tests whether extraction handles implicit item lists and what confidence score results.
tests.notes: Expected to be low confidence due to implicit item reference — Human Review with operator deciding whether to look up previous order.

tests.label: Email – Zero Price (Contract Draw)
tests.description: Known buyer submits a Q2 release against an annual prepaid contract. All line prices are 0.00 per the contract billing arrangement, not as an attempt to exploit pricing. Tests ZERO_PRICE_ACTION policy routing.
tests.notes: Expected outcome depends on ZERO_PRICE_ACTION setting. Default 'review' routes to Human Review. Set to 'reject' to silently reject; 'approve' to pass through to ERP.

tests.label: Email – Zero Price (Warranty Replacement)
tests.description: Known buyer submits a warranty replacement order referencing an approved RMA. Line prices are 0.00 per the MSA warranty clause, with finance approval forwarded in the email thread. Tests ZERO_PRICE_ACTION policy routing.
tests.notes: Expected outcome depends on ZERO_PRICE_ACTION setting. Default 'review' routes to Human Review. Set to 'reject' to silently reject; 'approve' to pass through to ERP.
